investigation: Theta-kernel tail and certified-height weighted defect
status: Proved analytic formulas with cited published inputs; decimal evaluations are mpmath, not interval-certified; RH not proved

unconditional_jacobi_theta_jensen_bound.derivation: N_line(T)<=log[xi(1/2+2T)/xi(1/2)]/(2 log 2); bound tail by 2L^2/log2 times integral from T to infinity of [t/(L^2+t^2)^2] log[xi(1/2+2t)/xi(1/2)] dt
unconditional_jacobi_theta_jensen_bound.sharpness: Valid but looser than total-minus-200 residual; establishes O(log(T)/T) decay unconditionally.

published_zero_count_upper.citation: Bellotti and Wong, Mathematics of Computation, electronically published 2025-11-14, doi:10.1090/mcom/4133

published_RH_verified_height.citation: Platt and Trudgian 2021, Bull LMS, doi:10.1112/blms.12460

first_200_line_tail_two_sided.certification_caveat: Bounds are rigorous symbolically, but reported R_200 decimal endpoints require independently certified zero ordinate enclosures.

positive_even_kernel_counterexample: Convolution of uniform box with two positive Gaussians: Fourier transform sinc(t)*(exp(-t^2/2)+exp(-2t^2))/2 has infinitely many real zeros and off-real zeros at t^2=-2*pi*i*(2k+1)/3.
conclusion: The uncounted on-line tail is tightly bounded numerically if published finite-height RH verification is used, but no positive bound proves the RH-equivalent defect is zero.
